best_echo_sets.commentary: Carlotta's best set bar none, that gives her an unconditional 12% Skill DMG Bonus, 22.5% Glacio DMG Bonus and up to an extra 36% Skill DMG Bonus when casting 2 or more Ultimates (a condition that she easily fulfills). Overall gives a total of 70.5% DMG Bonus at maximum which should speak volumes on how good this set is for Carlotta.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: The best Main Echo choice for the Frosty Resolve set as it grants 12% Glacio DMG and 12% Skill DMG Bonus when equipped in the main slot. Its active skill also deals a chunk of damage while freezing enemies in place for a short amount of time if fully stacked (which only Carlotta can do). The base cast can also be used during optimized Opener rotations to squeeze a small amount of extra damage.

cons: Her teammates are either very high-value (Lynae/Mornye) or have not reran in ages (Zhezhi) so it's unlikely most players have a strong team for her;
Low Quickswap compatibility because of major Ultimate self-buffs expiring on Swap;
Completely useless in Whimpering Wastes. Zero reason to be used over almost any more recent characters, even in F2P teams compared to Carlotta's full premium.
pros: Probably the most consistent DPS in the game. All of her and her teammates' attacks are ranged in all of her best teams, so she will very rarely (if ever) get interrupted by enemy attacks (so long as you space yourself properly during her Ultimate, but that isn't hard to do at all);
Does not need her Signature weapon to perform in the slightest - Phasic Homogenizer's existence makes it one of the most skippable Signature weapons in the game.
Managed to survive powercreep decently despite being a very old character.

sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Carlotta is a 5-star Glacio Pistol DPS who has a large portion of her damage window gated behind her Ultimate. She was the first ever character to possess 2 different Ultimates, she uniquely can cast up to 6 different attacks each counted as an Ultimate, and she is still one of the most ranged damage dealers in the game, making her great at avoiding enemy attacks. Carlotta is a character who is defined by her rotation consistency and her ease of use, following a traditional playstyle of building up a Forte gauge to unleash the biggest portion of her damage.

sections.heading: Key Mechanics & Rotation Concepts
paragraphs: Like many older characters, Carlotta is a fundamentally simple character to understand. She wants to build up Substance, her first Forte gauge, through Skills and Intros. This allows her to cast a special Heavy Attack that consumes this Forte gauge, which she can then follow with her Ultimate. After casting it, she has access to 4 special ranged attacks called Death Knells that, when cast, follow into her final Ultimate, ending her rotation.

Other than this, Carlotta will inflict a debuff called Deconstruction which allows her to ignore 18% of enemy DEF using all of the most relevant attacks in her rotation. She can also stun enemies for 1.5s upon hitting them with her first Skill. She may only use her enhanced Forte Heavy Attack every 22s, and her Ultimate once every 25s. Those represent almost all of her damage (aside from her Skills that also have a 14s cooldown), so overall she is very cooldown-gated when it comes to her key abilities.

Finally, provided Carlotta has cast her Forte Heavy Attack before her Ultimate, she gains an 80% buff to all damage multipliers in her Ultimate window, that expires upon switching her out. It is hence heavily disincentivized to switch her out once her Ultimate has been cast. Her Outro is a simple burst of damage like several older DPS Outros, nothing special there. Her most noteworthy mechanic is her ability to cast 6 different attacks counted as Ultimates (her 4 Death Knells and her 2 Ultimates), which has been used for temporary endgame buffs when she was still recently released, however this mechanic has not been utilized for a while at this point.

sections.heading: Meta Position & Conclusion
paragraphs: Carlotta is one of the simplest characters to understand meta-wise in the game. She has two main routes for her premium teams: Zhezhi + Shorekeeper, her on-release team or Lynae + Mornye, the recent universal buffing core released in version 3.0. While in theory, Lynae Mornye is Carlotta's best team, they are so high-value for modern damage dealers with a higher ceiling than Carlotta that most players still stick to a Zhezhi Shorekeeper team if they have access to it. And for the players who don't... Carlotta's performance becomes undeniably subpar.

While it's true that on her release, Carlotta w	as the uncontested best DPS in the game, in the modern era we currently are a part of, she only really sees use in the side towers of ToA, or in Endstate Matrix. Her lack of significant, constant AoE damage makes her a really bad pick for Whimpering Wastes, the middle floors of ToA are nowadays too tanky for casual players to do well given the current difficulty, and Carlotta now needs Sequence Nodes or temporary endgame buffs more than ever to be able to clear the game's hardest content. Her most recent buff is the release of the new 3.0 permanent banner weapons, among which is Phasic Homogenizer, a fantastic DPS Pistol that renders her Signature weapon completely skippable. However, it did not increase her damage ceiling - it only made her more accessible for budgeting (and it doesn't change the fact that she still needs premium teammates to perform).

In conclusion, Carlotta is nowadays not a recommended pull. There are too many newer, more performant damage dealers who work across all endgames and share similar qualities to her to consider her a worthwhile pull. However, for players who already own her, she remains easily usable in some of the game's easier content, provided you surround her with the right teammates. It's still completely true that Carlotta is a consistent and easy-to-pilot character, and those are her main strengths that players who can make use of her will get to enjoy even today.

synergies.commentary: Carlotta's best buffers and second slot partners as she ideally works in hypercarry compositions. Zhezhi and Lynae are easily the best ones as Lynae has a ton of super strong generalist buffs while Zhezhi gives Carlotta a lot of Energy to lower her Energy Regen requirements while also giving the highest DMG Amplification of all her Supports (45% total) and having fast rotation times, enabling consistent 25s team loops. Brant and Cantarella are good alternatives as while they only provide 25% DMG Amplification, they both have solid personal damage and retain reasonable rotation times.

Free-to-play accessible secondary characters for Carlotta teams. While Yangyang does not give any major buffs to Carlotta, her super fast rotation and extra Energy funneling via Outro (reminiscent of Zhezhi) make Carlotta easy to build and rotate with, while she can rely on her third slot partner for extra buffs making the team viable. While Taoqi does have 38% Skill DMG Amplification on her Outro, it does come at the cost of a rather slow and clunky rotation, next to nonexistent personal damage and she does also increase Carlotta's Energy Regen requirements. Overall, Yangyang will be much easier to play but Taoqi can yield higher results if played at her best. Choose based on what category of player you fit in.

These are all of Carlotta's 3rd slot teammate options. Mornye has a special synergy with Lynae since Lynae can apply Tune Rupture/Strain for Mornye to respond to them and provide her full array of buffs, making her the best choice if Lynae is in use. Shorekeeper and Verina are the next best ones as they tend to be some of the best generalist Supports for all ATK and CRIT-scaling DPS due to their super high buffs for short rotation times. Buling still does present herself as a good F2P alternative because Buling trades team-wide ATK buffs for Skill DMG buffs to Carlotta and more personal damage for slightly higher rotation times, which makes her not too far behind Verina, equaling her when optimized at S6.
